description: Read-only RoadSense versioned image probe; fixed reviewed commands and bounded inputs.

runCommand:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
[[ "$SSM_ArchiveSha256" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
[[ "$SSM_ImageVersion" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9+/=._-]{1,128}$ ]]
expected_arn='arn:aws:sts::918870682888:assumed-role/SynergieSSMHybridManagedInstanceCore/mi-0dade13fd68d1b435'
test "$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Arn --output text)" = "$expected_arn"
bucket='synergie-production-app-backups-918870682888-ap-south-1'
key="applications/roadsense/images/${SSM_ArchiveSha256}/roadsense-image.tar"
head="$(aws s3api head-object --bucket "$bucket" --key "$key" --version-id "$SSM_ImageVersion" --query '{Length:ContentLength,Sha:Metadata.sha256,Encryption:ServerSideEncryption}' --output json)"
test "$(jq -r '.Sha' <<< "$head")" = "$SSM_ArchiveSha256"
test "$(jq -r '.Encryption' <<< "$head")" = 'AES256'
size="$(jq -r '.Length' <<< "$head")"
[[ "$size" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
available="$(df -B1 /tmp | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')"
[[ "$available" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
(( available > size * 2 ))
tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d /tmp/roadsense-artifact-probe.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"' EXIT
version="$(aws s3api get-object --bucket "$bucket" --key "$key" --version-id "$SSM_ImageVersion" "$tmp_dir/roadsense-image.tar" --query VersionId --output text)"
test "$version" = "$SSM_ImageVersion"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$SSM_ArchiveSha256" "$tmp_dir/roadsense-image.tar" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null
if aws s3api head-object --bucket "$bucket" --key 'applications/roadsense/release-candidates/aaac711b0df078d12714bbd03cff72df7ae49418b8434be1a2864f1536575fa1/road_safety_pilot.sqlite' --version-id 'fa2rByaK4AljcFIOosf0ftI5602evy7c' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'UNRELATED_VERSIONED_READ_UNEXPECTEDLY_ALLOWED' >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "ROAD_SENSE_PROBE_ARCHIVE_SHA256=$SSM_ArchiveSha256"
echo "ROAD_SENSE_PROBE_IMAGE_S3_VERSION=$version"
echo 'ROAD_SENSE_PROBE_UNRELATED_READ=DENIED'
